title: Tsigirai My Quiet Bible
description: My Quiet Bible ndeyemahara kuvanhu vose, nekusingaperi. Kana ichikubatsirai, munogona kubatsira kuti mwenje urambe uchibvira.
sub: Mahara kuvanhu vose, nekusingaperi. Kana ichikubatsirai, munogona kubatsira kuti mwenje urambe uchibvira.
kofiSub: Kamwe chete, kana mwedzi wega wega. Nekadhi, Apple Pay kana Google Pay, pasina kunyoresa.
leave: Inovhurika papeji itsva. Dzokai pano, kana kuBhaibheri, kana mapedza.
btcSub: On-chain kana Lightning, zvakananga kusevha yedu, pasina murevereri kana mumwe munhu.
where:
• Masevha anoita kuti kuwiriranisa nemapoka zvirambe zvichishanda.
  • Mazita edhomeni, kuti myquietbible.com irambe ichishanda.
  • Email inotumira makodhi ekupinda.
never: Hapana chiri muBhaibheri chichazombokiyiwa. Kupa kuonga, kwete tikiti rekupinda, uye hapana chinoshanduka muapp kunyange mapa kana kuti kwete.
tax: My Quiet Bible haisi sangano rerubatsiro rakanyoreswa, saka zvipo hazvideredzi mutero wenyu.
other:
• Namatirai basa iri, nevanhu vanoverenga naro.
  • Tumirai myquietbible.com kune munhu angada Bhaibheri rakanyarara.
